name: St25R Spi → On Tag
description:
An automation to perform when a tag is first read. See [`on_tag` Trigger](https://esphome.io/components/st25r/#on_tag-trigger).

This automation is triggered when a tag is read. The UID is available as `x`, a `std::string` in the format `74-10-37-94`, and the tag as `tag`, an `nfc::NfcTag`.
